description.en: hooks-adapter — reuse hooks configs from Claude Code, Codex, opencode or native dsh on the DeepSeek Harness: maps lifecycle events and runs shell, webhook, oracle and proxy handlers.
description.zh: 钩子兼容层：把 Claude Code / Codex / opencode 的 hooks 配置复用到 dsh，支持 shell、webhook、oracle 与 proxy 四种处理器。
